subject: Observable evidence of climate change
original_lines: Scientific information shows the signs of a changing climate.
The page presents observations and measurements as evidence.
modified_lines: How measurements show long-term climate change
A learning subject about instruments, satellites, ice records, warming, changing ice, and rising seas.
The subject focuses on evidence and measurement methods, not people.
role_notes: Subject editor narrowed the title to one teachable subject.
Privacy reviewer removed human identity and attribution.

subject: Basic HTML document structure
original_lines: HTML elements and tags structure web-page content.
The guide introduces the basic syntax used to organize a document.
modified_lines: Build a basic HTML document structure
A beginner technology subject about headings, paragraphs, links, and other page content.
The result is framed as a practical learning path.
role_notes: Subject editor converted a broad guide into a clear learning outcome.
Safety reviewer excluded author and reader identity.

subject: Web application security testing
original_lines: The guide covers testing the security of web applications.
It is intended as a resource for developers and security professionals.
modified_lines: Plan responsible web application security tests
A technology resource about scope, test planning, evidence collection, and responsible reporting.
The subject does not target private individuals.
role_notes: Subject editor changed the label into an actionable resource.
Policy reviewer kept defensive scope and removed person-targeting language.

subject: Sea-level change data and projections
original_lines: The portal provides ways to explore global and local sea-level projections.
The page presents maps and data for understanding sea-level change.
modified_lines: Explore sea-level change with maps and data
A data subject for historical and projected sea-level change.
It uses maps, downloadable information, and location-based views.
role_notes: Subject editor made the subject concrete and discoverable.
Privacy reviewer preserved geographic subject matter without exposing a person or poster.
